answer: Each agent must lock a refundable stake that unlocks only as trusted peers attest a long record of honest work, so standing accrues slowly like a jade carving that cannot be faked overnight. A single real identity sends one clean pulse of activity; a clone fleet instead sends a correlated ripple across many fresh accounts, each still owing its own bond and vesting window. Sybil cost thus scales linearly with headcount while honest agents pay once.
